subject: scripts/verify_tranche_audit.py run against the CLAUDE-FRESH-B3C audit, and what each residual FAIL means
why_this_note_exists: The verifier returns FAIL overall. None of the residual failures indicates a defect in the audit or in the 28 questions released from it, and saying so requires going through them one at a time rather than reporting a bare verdict.

runs.note: the freeze commit the audit branch was cut from; makes check 03 meaningful, fails check 04 on field semantics
the represented candidate; check 04 PASSES, and check 03 then also counts the freeze package files added between the candidate and the branch

residual_failures.observed: against the freeze base the branch changes one file more than the contract allows: audits/remediation/2026-08-20/B3C-PHASE1-BLIND-LOCK.json
residual_failures.explanation: CLAUDE-FRESH-B3C hit an API session limit mid-audit and was resumed. Its first run wrote B3C-PHASE1-BLIND-LOCK.json using answers[]/blind_selected_choice_ids; the resumed run wrote CLAUDE-FRESH-B3C-PHASE1-BLIND-LOCK.json using the questions[]/selected_choice_ids schema the verifier reads. Both are the same auditor's work on the same package, and the two locks agree with each other on all 33 items. This is a tidiness defect caused by the controller's dispatch prompt naming field names that did not match the established schema, not a second audit and not contamination.
residual_failures.fixed_forward: The B3-D v3, B3-E v3 and B3-F dispatch prompts specify the verifier's exact schema and filename. All three locks landed conformant on the first attempt.

residual_failures.observed: the records' bound hashes no longer match current for the tranche as a whole
residual_failures.explanation: MA-Q-0311 and MA-Q-0322 were edited after the audit, by the tranche SATA correct-count correction. Neither was released. The other 31 questions' hashes are unchanged, which is what the release actually rested on: every hash in the release config was checked against the hashes pinned in the B3C legal and realism contracts at the freeze commit.
Exactly the two questions the controller edited and deliberately withheld from release. The check is reporting the intended state.

The check measures the bank as it stands now. CLAUDE-FRESH-B3C audited when the bank held 327 questions; it now holds 406 because B3-D, B3-E and B3-F were authored afterwards. The check can only pass at the moment of the audit, and it reports no defects.

residual_failures.observed: blind_package_blob null; blind_mismatches ['MA-Q-0311', 'MA-Q-0322']; 31 of 33 blind answers match the current keys
residual_failures.explanation: Two separate things. The conformant lock omits the blind_package_blob field, which the controller's prompt did not require. And the two blind mismatches are the two questions whose keys the controller changed after the audit: the auditor's blind answers matched the keys as they stood when it locked. Contamination is CLEAN and all four not-inspected-before-lock flags are false.

release_partition_from_the_verifier.difference_explained: The verifier's partition does not apply hash currency. MA-Q-0311 and MA-Q-0322 are in its eligible 30 but were withheld because their hashes moved after the audit; they are carried into the CLAUDE-FRESH-B3D-V3 package for a first audit at their current hash.

conclusion: Every residual failure is explained by the controller's own later edits, the growth of the bank since the audit, or a controller-caused prompt defect. Check 16, no hidden current-hash failure among eligible questions, passes. The 28-question release stands.
